result.title: DynMF2: Rigid Motion Factorization by Expectation-Maximization for Monocular 4D Reconstruction and Motion Segmentation
result.summary: A single casual video leaves a moving scene under-determined: a point seen once from each place can slide toward or away from the camera and still match every frame. We constrain the reconstruction with the structure of the motion itself. Building on DynMF, we model a scene's motion as a handful of SE(3) trajectories, each rigid, and let every point follow one of them alone, never a blend. DynMF2 computes this factorization directly from 3D point trajectories, with no rendering, by Expectation-Maximization (EM). Its M-step fits, in closed form, every rigid motion to the points assigned to it, and its E-step reassigns every point to the motion that explains it with the least error. The background is simply one more motion, the camera's, so no masks are needed. Three tools then revise the factorization: requery adds trajectories where the rendering shows parts the tracker missed, merge joins motions that move together, and split separates those that do not. Thus the number of motions follows the scene. Without masks, DynMF2 clearly outperforms the mask-based baselines in view synthesis on iPhone and NVIDIA and in 3D tracking on iPhone. It recovers what masks leave out, from thin parts and details to small movers far in the background. Its motions segment the moving parts of MOVi-F and iTACO scenes competitively, although DynMF2 is never trained to segment. What moves in a scene is not decided in advance: it emerges from the rigid motions themselves.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DynMF2，将单目视频中的场景运动分解为若干条刚性 SE(3) 轨迹，用 EM 直接从 3D 点轨迹求解：M 步闭式拟合各运动，E 步把每个点硬分配给误差最小的运动，再用 requery/merge/split 增删运动数量，无需掩码，在视图合成与 3D 跟踪上优于基于掩码的基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 「每点只归属一个运动、不混合」的硬分配加上分裂合并自适应确定运动数，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的归属、增删与证据筛选提供概念参照；但对象是几何重建而非 VLM 推理状态，迁移可行性尚需核查。
